fix: Keep unedited constant AAC presentation origins as rational media times, subtract seek and packet coordinates before ceil-to-native-sample cropping, and stamp the retained PCM at its exact rational origin. Reuse the existing rational crop path; edit and changing-description policies retain their dispatch.
independent_scope: The media clock is an exact multiple of the sample frequency, so there is no recovered PlaybackClock, yet CTTS need not align to native samples. This is a fractional origin/crop error at middle-of-stream seeks, independent of FVID-0416 endpoint bounds. All rate, sign, seek and worker variants count as one fix.
